title: Updating a derived QoS rule by reflective QoS in the UE

entities.name: Derived QoS Rule
entities.description: A QoS rule derived by the UE for uplink traffic based on downlink user data packets with reflective QoS indication.

entities.name: Downlink User Data Packet
entities.description: A packet received by the UE in the downlink direction that contains QFI and RQI parameters.

entities.name: QoS Flow Identifier
entities.description: Identifies a specific QoS flow within a PDU session.

entities.name: Reflective QoS Indication
entities.description: Indicates that reflective QoS is applied to the user data packet.

entities.name: Timer T3583
entities.description: Timer associated with a derived QoS rule for managing reflective QoS validity.

entities.name: RQ Timer Value
entities.description: The timer value for reflective QoS, received during PDU session procedures or using a default standardized value.

entities.name: Packet Filter Match Condition
entities.description: Condition where the UE has a derived QoS rule with the same UL packet filter as derived from the DL user data packet.

entities.name: QFI Update Condition
entities.description: Condition where the QFI value in the DL user data packet differs from the stored QFI value in the derived QoS rule.

relations.description: DL user data packet triggers evaluation of packet filter match condition.
When packet filter match condition is met, UE restarts timer T3583.
Timer T3583 uses the RQ timer value received during PDU session procedures or default value.
When QFI update condition is met, UE updates the QFI value in the derived QoS rule.
DL user data packet provides the QFI value that triggers QFI update condition evaluation.
